name: @sharedid-edge/module-id5
description: SharedID Edge module: the ID5 ID, fetched server-to-server from ID5 with your own partner number. Opt-in; sends the client IP, user agent and SharedID to ID5

sharedidEdge.name: id5
sharedidEdge.title: ID5 ID, fetched server-to-server
sharedidEdge.summary: The ID5 ID as an EID, fetched from ID5 by the worker with your own ID5 partner number, cached in an `HttpOnly` cookie; nothing without ID5's TCF vendor consent where GDPR applies, or on opt-out, GPC, COPPA or a US opt-out. Off unless you turn it on
